blogs.title: The 1.58-Bit Revolution: Understanding the New Math of AI
blogs.description: An accessible breakdown of the paper's core innovation: ternary weights. This post explains what it means for a model to use only {-1, 0, 1} values, why it is called '1.58 bits', and how this simplification mimics the brain's ability to filter features without losing intelligence.

blogs.title: Beating LLaMA at Its Own Game: High Performance at Low Precision
blogs.description: A deep dive into the performance benchmarks. This post compares BitNet b1.58 against the standard LLaMA architecture, highlighting how the 1-bit variant matches perplexity and task performance starting at 3B parameters while offering significantly faster inference speeds.

blogs.title: Cheaper, Faster, Greener: The Economic Case for 1-Bit LLMs
blogs.description: Focusing on the efficiency metrics that matter to businesses and researchers. This article explores the massive reduction in memory footprint, throughput improvements (up to 8.9x), and the staggering 71.4x energy savings for arithmetic operations, arguing for a more sustainable future for AI.

blogs.title: AI in Your Pocket: How 1-Bit Architectures Are Democratizing LLMs
blogs.description: A forward-looking piece on the implications for edge computing and mobile devices. This post discusses how the reduced memory and compute requirements allow massive models to run on consumer hardware and calls for a new generation of specialized hardware designed specifically for 1-bit math.
